conflictResolutionStrategy.prohibited: No automatic winner chosen from branch date, filename, or recency alone.

semanticCollisionAudit.method: Normalize JSON object keys and order of unique provenance_refs only. Compare full normalized documents; never ignore value, status, other arrays or canonical IDs.
semanticCollisionAudit.limitation: Semantic equivalence is not approval of DRAFT translations, canonical-owner election or permission for main. The 58 others are not necessarily all textually distinct: most were outside the narrow allowlist.
